title: How Does a Lightning Rod Work?
description:
That thin metal rod on top of tall buildings was Benjamin Franklin's idea. Lightning follows the easiest path to the ground, so a metal rod guides the strike safely round the building and into the earth instead of setting a wooden roof on fire.
